P.name: Mortal Will
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Pantheon''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Mortal Will'' whenever he lands a {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}} or casts an {{tip|ability}}, stacking up to 5 times. At 5 stacks, '''Pantheon's''' next basic ability consumes the stacks to become empowered with an additional effect.
P.description2: '''Pantheon''' gains maximum stacks of ''Mortal Will'' upon starting the game, completing a {{si|Recall}} channel, and [[death|respawning]].

Q.name: Comet Spear
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pantheon''' {{tip|channel|charges}} while being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 10% for up to 4 seconds to increase ''Comet Spear's'' {{sti|range}} after {{fd|0.35}} seconds of channeling. ''Comet Spear'' can be recast within the duration.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Pantheon''' hurls his spear in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, {{ccs|increased|physical}} against enemies {{as|below 20% of their '''maximum''' health}} but reduced by 50% against enemies beyond the first.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Hurl Physical Damage|{{ap|70 to 190}} {{as|(+ 115% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Increased Hurl Damage|{{ap|155 to 455}} {{as|(+ 230% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}}}
{{st|Hurl Secondary Physical Damage|{{ap|70*0.5 to 190*0.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|115*0.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*0.5}}% AP)}}|Increased Hurl Secondary Damage|{{ap|155*0.5 to 455*0.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|230*0.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100*0.5}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description3: Releasing the ability within {{fd|0.35}} seconds causes '''Pantheon''' to instead thrust his spear in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, {{ccs|increased|physical}} against enemies {{as|below 20% of their '''maximum''' health}}, and refunding 60% of ''Comet Spear's'' {{sti|cooldown}}. The thrust's damage is not reduced against enemies beyond the first.
Q.leveling3: {{st|Thrust Physical Damage|{{ap|70 to 190}} {{as|(+ 115% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Increased Thrust Damage|{{ap|155 to 455}} {{as|(+ 230% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description4: ''Comet Spear's'' total damage is reduced to 80% against {{tip|monsters}} and to 70% against {{tip|minions}}.
Q.description5: If the charge is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} or completes without reactivation, ''Comet Spear'' is cancelled and the ability is put on full cooldown but refunds {{sti|mana|{{as|half the mana cost}}}}.
Q.description6: {{sbc|{{ai|Mortal Will|Pantheon}}:}} ''Comet Spear'' deals {{as|{{pp|20 + (240-20)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 115% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, affected by the previous damage reductions. Consumes the stacks upon recasting.

W.name: Shield Vault
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pantheon''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the front of the target enemy's location. If the target is within 800 units upon arrival, he deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for 1 second. Against minions and monsters, ''Shield Vault'' has a minimum damage of 60 and is capped at 150.
W.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|6 to 8}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% per 100 AP)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.4}}% per 100 '''Pantheon's''' '''bonus''' health)}}}}
W.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Mortal Will|Pantheon}}:}} '''Pantheon''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 4 seconds to have a {{fd|0.375}}-second cast time and strike the target 3 times over a brief period, dealing {{as|{{pp|120/3 to 165/3|key=%}} AD}} {{as|physical damage}} per hit, up to {{as|{{pp|120 + (165-120)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} AD}}. Each hit is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers and applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
W.description3: ''Empowered Shield Vault {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Pantheon's''' basic attack timer.''

E.name: Aegis Assault
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pantheon''' braces his shield in the target direction and {{tip|channel|channels}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which he becomes {{tip|invulnerability|invulnerable}} to non-{{tip|turret}} damage dealt by enemies from the target direction. He also continually performs strikes in a cone in front of him, dealing {{as|{{fd|8.{{recurring|3}}}}% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} every {{fd|0.125}} seconds to enemies hit, reduced by 50% against {{tip|minions}} and up to {{as|100% AD}} {{as|'''total''' physical damage}}.
E.description2: ''Aegis Assault'' can be recast after {{fd|0.3}} seconds, and does so automatically after the duration. ''Aegis Assault's'' channel cannot be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} by {{tip|crowd control}}.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Pantheon''' slams with his shield in a cone in front of him, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
E.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|Mortal Will|Pantheon}}:}} After recasting, '''Pantheon''' gains {{pp|5 + (30-5)/17*(x-1) for 20}} {{as|(+ {{fd|2.5}}% '''bonus''' health)}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} for 4 seconds as well as {{sti|{{as|60% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
E.description5: '''''Pantheon''' can move during the cast time of Aegis Assault's recast.''

R.name: Grand Starfall
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pantheon''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for 2 seconds before leaping into the sky, causing him to {{tip|vanish}} and become {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}}. He continues {{tip|channel|channeling}} for {{fd|2.25}} seconds and grants {{tip|sight}} around the target location {{fd|0.5}} seconds into the channel.
R.description3: After {{tt|{{fd|0.8}}|Estimated}} seconds into the channel, '''Pantheon''' hurls his spear to the target location over {{tt|{{fd|0.2}}|Estimated}} seconds that deals {{as|{{pp|type=[[File:Comet Spear.png|20px|border]] ''Comet Spear's'' rank|40 to 190 for 6|0 to 5|formula=40 + 30 per rank of ''Comet Spear''}} {{as|(+ 115% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} physical damage|physical damage}} to enemies near the impact and {{tip|slows}} them by 50% for 2 seconds.
R.description4: Over the remaining {{tt|{{fd|1.25}}|Estimated}} seconds, '''Pantheon''' crashes down after {{tt|{{fd|0.55}}|Estimated}} seconds and creates a shockwave alongside himself that travels toward the target location over {{tt|{{fd|0.7}}|Estimated}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, reduced by up to 50% for those hit at the edge of the area. Upon completion of the channel, '''Pantheon''' will lose the {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} and {{tip|blink|reappear}} at the target location, as well as gain maximum stacks of ''{{ai|Mortal Will|Pantheon}}''.
R.leveling4: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|300 to 700}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|300/2 to 700/2}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
R.description5: ''Grand Starfall'' is placed on a {{sti|cd|30-second}} cooldown if the first channel is canceled.
